subject: Materials Science
title: Nanomedicine: Diagnosis and Therapy
description: A short lesson to help you apply Nanomedicine: Diagnosis and Therapy.

hook.text: Nanoparticles that find a tumor, light it up for imaging, and deliver chemotherapy — theranostics in one tiny package.

buildup.text: Theranostic nanoparticles combine diagnosis and therapy — imaging agents and drugs in the same nanocarrier.

discovery.text: Magnetic nanoparticles guide drugs to tumors with magnets — then heat under alternating fields to kill cancer.

twist.text: Clinical translation is slow — only about 15 nanomedicines are FDA-approved despite thousands of lab publications.

climax.text: COVID mRNA vaccines use lipid nanoparticles — the biggest nanomedicine success, delivering RNA to billions of people.

punchline.text: Nanoparticles delivered the pandemic vaccine — nanomedicine's defining moment.

quiz.question: What are theranostic nanoparticles?
options: Nanoparticles that combine diagnostic imaging and therapeutic drug delivery
